repos.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
repos.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 175,000+ scientists worldwide. 163 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive library of validated agent skills designed to transform AI models into autonomous scientific researchers.
bullets: Built on a modular Python architecture with 163 validated, reusable agent skills.
Integrates with over 100 scientific databases to provide domain-specific context for AI agents.
Enables automated hypothesis generation, data analysis, and literature review workflows.
Used by researchers to scale complex scientific experimentation and data processing tasks.

repos.name: tt-a1i/archify
repos.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
repos.one_liner: An agent-driven tool for generating verifiable, interactive architecture and data-flow diagrams.
bullets: Generates self-contained HTML files featuring motion-based visualization and crisp exports.
Focuses on verifiable documentation, ensuring diagrams accurately reflect underlying system architecture.
Supports complex sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle modeling for technical infrastructure.
Ideal for developers needing to document complex distributed systems or fintech data pipelines.

repos.name: every-app/open-seo
repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.one_liner: An open-source, high-performance alternative to enterprise SEO platforms like Semrush and Ahrefs.
bullets: Built with a modern TypeScript stack optimized for large-scale data crawling and indexing.
Provides comprehensive site auditing, keyword tracking, and competitive intelligence tools.
Reduces infrastructure costs for marketing teams by replacing expensive SaaS subscriptions.
Designed for developers to self-host and integrate SEO analytics directly into their own dashboards.

repos.name: miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web
repos.description: Use ChatGPT Pro as a native model in the Codex app — with context, compaction, streaming, images, and optional MCP tools.
repos.one_liner: A bridge application that integrates ChatGPT Pro as a native model within the Codex development environment.
bullets: Utilizes a TypeScript-based architecture to handle streaming, context compaction, and image processing.
Supports optional MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to extend agent capabilities.
Allows developers to maintain a 'planning brain' via ChatGPT while executing code via Codex.
Streamlines the development workflow by unifying conversational planning and code generation.

repos.name: chrisgreg/boop
repos.description: A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone.
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, self-hosted notification inbox designed specifically for developer infrastructure monitoring.
bullets: Written in Go for high performance and minimal resource footprint in production environments.
Provides a centralized hub for aggregating alerts from multiple disparate applications.
Delivers real-time push notifications to mobile devices for immediate incident response.
Ideal for monitoring fintech trading bots, server health, or automated deployment pipelines.
